Meta.title: Causius — understand and answer legal letters
Meta.description: Causius reads an official letter with you: what it says, what it asks for and by when. When you need a person, it hands the case to a legal assistant or a licensed lawyer.

Footer.disclaimer: Beta: running, not released. Causius AI gives legal information, not legal advice. Only a lawyer licensed where your case is may advise you on it or represent you.
Footer.solon: How it is governed, on Solon

Home.title: Understand the letter. Answer it in time.
Home.lead: An official letter arrives in a language you half read, with a deadline and a paragraph number. Causius tells you what it says, what it wants from you and by when, and points you to a person when a person is what you need.

one.title: Show it the letter
one.body: Paste the text or photograph the pages. Choose the languages you read best.

two.title: See what it wants
two.body: A plain summary, the deadline, each thing asked of you as a checklist, a full translation and a draft reply.

three.title: Bring in a person
three.body: Export the case file and hand it to a legal assistant or a licensed lawyer, who starts from the facts instead of from zero.

Home.tiersTitle: Three kinds of help, and an honest line between them
Home.tiersLead: Most legal trouble starts as paperwork, and most paperwork does not need a lawyer. Some of it does. Causius keeps the difference visible.

ai.name: Causius AI
ai.can: Reads, translates, lists what is asked and drafts a reply.
ai.limit: Legal information only. It does not advise or represent you.

assistant.name: Legal assistants
assistant.can: People who know the paperwork: gathering evidence, forms, filing, translation. They may work under a pseudonym.
assistant.limit: Not lawyers. They help you do it; they do not give legal advice.

lawyer.name: Licensed lawyers
lawyer.can: Admitted to practise where your case is; their admission is verified. They advise and can represent you, and may appear under a pseudonym until you engage them.
lawyer.limit: Licensed per jurisdiction: a lawyer in one country cannot advise on another's law.

Home.marketplaceLink: How the marketplace works, and how to join it
Home.privacyBody: This version has no accounts. A case is kept in your browser, on your device, and nowhere else. Before a letter is sent for analysis, your name, address and numbers are replaced in your browser, so the model provider never sees them; Causius stores nothing. You can export a case anonymised for a helper, and delete it.

byHand.title: File it by hand
byHand.body: No analysis, but the letter and its deadline are kept together, and the case file can be handed to a helper. Already have a case file?

errors.not_configured: The free shared models are not switched on for this site right now. You can connect your own model, or file the letter by hand and keep track of its deadline.
errors.busy: No model answered. The free shared budget for today may be used up, or a provider is down. Your own model is not affected by the shared budget.
errors.busy_own: Your model did not answer. The key may have run out of credit or been revoked. Check it in the settings, or remove it to use the free shared models.
errors.no_vision: None of the models available right now can read a photo. Paste the letter's text instead, or connect your own model that can read images.
errors.rate_limited: That is a lot of letters in a short time. The free shared models allow a few per hour; your own model allows many more.
errors.bad_own_model: Your saved model settings could not be used. Set them up again.
errors.unreadable_analysis: The model answered, but not in a form Causius could turn into a case. Try again; a stronger model does this more reliably.
errors.empty: Paste the letter's text or add a photo of it.
errors.bad_image: That file could not be used as a photo. Send a JPEG, PNG or WebP image.
errors.too_many_pages: That is more than {max} pages. Add the pages that carry the request and the deadline.
errors.offline: Causius could not be reached. Check your connection and try again.
errors.unknown: The analysis did not go through. Try again in a minute.

Helpers.metaDescription: The Causius marketplace: legal assistants who help with paperwork, and licensed lawyers who can advise and represent you.
Helpers.title: People who help when the AI is not enough
Helpers.lead: Two kinds of people work on Causius cases. What separates them is not price or rank but what the law lets each of them do. Neither needs to know who you are, and you need not know who they are until you engage one.
Helpers.noneBody: Causius does not match or verify anyone yet. Until it does, use the case file with a lawyer or advice centre you find yourself: it is made to be handed over.

assistant.name: Legal assistant
assistant.does1: Explains procedure and what an office usually expects
assistant.does3: Fills in forms with you, translates, prepares the filing
assistant.doesNot: Does not give legal advice, take a position on your case, or represent you.
assistant.checks: Planned: reputation earned on completed cases, confirmed by the person who was helped. A pseudonym keeps its history, so it cannot be shed.

lawyer.name: Licensed lawyer
lawyer.identity: Name or pseudonym; admission verified privately
lawyer.does1: Advises you on your rights and your options
lawyer.does2: Reviews or writes what you send
lawyer.does3: Represents you before the authority or the court
lawyer.doesNot: Only for the jurisdictions they are admitted in, shown on their profile.
lawyer.checks: Planned: admission checked privately against the public bar register of each jurisdiction before a profile carries this label, and re-checked. A lawyer may appear under a pseudonym; you learn their name when you engage them, because the law ties a lawyer's duties to their name.

Helpers.wantBody: Helpers are not Causius accounts. You offer your help as a service on OrangeCat, under your name or a pseudonym, and are paid there directly by the person you helped. You can list a service today. Causius does not yet pull those listings in, label them or check a lawyer's admission; that is the next thing on the roadmap.

label.title: The label is the law
label.body: Who may give legal advice is set by each country, and almost everywhere it is reserved to admitted lawyers. A helper's label says which side of that line they are on, and they may not work past it.

pseudonym.title: Pseudonymous on every side
pseudonym.body: People seeking help, legal assistants and lawyers can all appear under a pseudonym. Causius checks privately what has to be true — that a lawyer is admitted — and shows only what is needed. Many people who know a system best learned it by going through it, and would rather not put their name to that.

share.title: You choose what a helper sees
share.body: A helper gets the case file you hand them and nothing else, and by default that file is anonymised: the case, the deadline and the letter, with your name, address and numbers replaced. You decide if and when to tell them more.

place.title: Any jurisdiction, one at a time
place.body: A case names where it is. Helpers are matched on that place, the area of law and a language you share.

Settings.metaDescription: Use your own AI model for Causius analyses.
Settings.title: Settings
Settings.p1: Without a key, Causius reads letters with free shared models. They have a small daily budget that every visitor draws on, and they are not the strongest available.
Settings.p2: A legal letter deserves the best reading you can give it. Connect an API key from a provider below and your analyses run on the strongest model that key can use, on your own budget. The key is kept in this browser only: it is sent with each analysis to reach your provider and is never stored by Causius.
Settings.p3: Use an API key, ideally one with a spending cap. Causius never asks for a subscription login such as Claude Pro or ChatGPT Plus.
Settings.keyKept: Key {hint}, kept in this browser only
Settings.notWrong: This does not mean the key is wrong.
Settings.saved: Saved in this browser. New analyses use it.
Settings.tooMany: Too many checks in a short time. Wait a few minutes and try again.
Settings.unreachable: Could not reach Causius to check the key. Check your connection.

Redact.title: Anonymise before sending
Redact.lead: Names, addresses and numbers that identify you are replaced with placeholders in your browser before the letter is sent. The model never sees them; your browser puts them back into the result.
Redact.ownWordsPlaceholder: Your name, your employer, a family member…
Redact.ownWordsHint: Separate with commas. Kept in this browser for your next letters.
Redact.found: {count, plural, =0 {Nothing will be hidden} one {# detail will be hidden} other {# details will be hidden}}. Tap one to send it after all.
Redact.foundNone: No personal details found in the text. Add your name above if it appears.
Redact.preview: Show exactly what the model receives
Redact.photosWarning: Photos are sent as they are. Cover your name, address and numbers on each page before sending.
Redact.offWarning: Anonymising is off: the letter is sent with every personal detail in it.
Redact.coveredCount: {count, plural, one {# area covered} other {# areas covered}}
Redact.photoHint: Drag a box over your name, address, and any number that identifies you. What is under a box is removed from the photo.
Redact.canvas: The page. Drag to cover an area.
